godotProjects.title: Godot Projects
godotProjects.description: Collection of XR and game development projects built with the Godot engine.
godotProjects.extendedDescription: A collection of projects built using the Godot game engine, focusing on XR development, VR games, and engine tooling. These projects showcase the capabilities of Godot for immersive experiences and contribute to the open-source XR ecosystem.

otherProjects.title: Other Projects
otherProjects.description: Various projects spanning graphics, XR, and game development.

godotDojo.title: Godot Dojo
godotDojo.description: Core developer on XR/VR demos enhancing Godot's XR functionality.
godotDojo.extendedDescription: Godot Dojo is an organization dedicated to advancing XR development in the Godot game engine. As a core developer, I've contributed to multiple VR demos and tools that showcase Godot's capabilities for virtual reality development. The collection includes games, tools, and experimental projects that push the boundaries of what's possible with open-source XR development.

wizardVsRobot.title: Wizard vs Robot
wizardVsRobot.description: VR locomotion, enemy AI with 6DoF, gesture-based movement.
wizardVsRobot.extendedDescription: Wizard vs Robot is an action-packed VR game featuring innovative locomotion mechanics and intelligent enemy AI with full 6 degrees of freedom. Players use gesture-based spellcasting to battle robotic enemies in immersive combat. The project showcases advanced VR interaction patterns and demonstrates smooth locomotion techniques that minimize motion sickness while maintaining gameplay intensity.

meshSlicerGodot.title: Mesh Slicer (Godot)
meshSlicerGodot.description: Runtime slicing plugin with cross-section textures and forces.
meshSlicerGodot.extendedDescription: A powerful runtime mesh slicing plugin for Godot that enables real-time cutting of 3D meshes along arbitrary planes. Features include automatic cross-section texture generation, physics-based forces applied to cut pieces, and efficient mesh regeneration. Perfect for games requiring destructible environments or slicing mechanics like fruit ninja-style games.

cppRaytracer.title: C++ Raytracer
cppRaytracer.description: Vulkan + ImGui ray tracer with path tracing and materials.
cppRaytracer.extendedDescription: A high-performance raytracer built from scratch in C++ using Vulkan for GPU acceleration and ImGui for real-time parameter adjustment. Implements physically-based path tracing with support for various material types including metals, dielectrics, and diffuse surfaces. The renderer supports multiple light types, importance sampling, and progressive refinement for high-quality output.

vrHorrorPrototype.title: VR Horror Prototype
vrHorrorPrototype.description: VR essentials, avatar integration, weapons and gestures.
vrHorrorPrototype.extendedDescription: A VR horror game prototype exploring essential mechanics for immersive scary experiences. Features include full body avatar integration using inverse kinematics, realistic weapon handling with haptic feedback, and gesture-based interactions for environmental puzzles. The project served as a testing ground for VR horror design patterns and atmospheric audio design.

threeDGestureRecognition.title: 3D Gesture Recognition
threeDGestureRecognition.description: Adapted $p algorithm to 3D; authorable templates and runtime.
threeDGestureRecognition.extendedDescription: An extension of the $P gesture recognition algorithm adapted for 3D space recognition. The system allows developers to author custom gesture templates through a visual editor and recognizes them at runtime with high accuracy. Particularly useful for VR/AR applications requiring custom hand or controller gesture inputs beyond standard button presses.

godotOculusPlatform.title: Godot Oculus Platform
godotOculusPlatform.description: C++/GDNative plugin exposing OAuth, rooms, leaderboards, etc.
godotOculusPlatform.extendedDescription: A comprehensive GDNative plugin for Godot that provides full access to the Oculus Platform SDK. Exposes features including OAuth authentication, matchmaking rooms, global leaderboards, achievements, in-app purchases, and social features. Enables Godot developers to publish fully-featured VR games on the Oculus/Meta Quest store.

mrEarthViewer.title: MR Earth Viewer
mrEarthViewer.description: MR Earth visualization built with Unity and Bing Maps SDK.
mrEarthViewer.extendedDescription: A Mixed Reality application that brings satellite imagery and 3D terrain data into your physical space. Built with Unity and the Bing Maps SDK, users can explore any location on Earth as a holographic globe or zoomed-in terrain model. Features include real-time weather data overlay, point-of-interest markers, and collaborative viewing for educational or planning purposes.

narakashur.title: Narakashur
narakashur.description: Standalone wave survival game for Jio Mixed Reality Glasses.
narakashur.extendedDescription: Narakashur is a wave survival game developed for Jio Mixed Reality Glasses, featuring 4 unique enemy types with distinct behaviors and attack patterns. Players defend against increasingly difficult waves using the device's unique control scheme. Includes a global leaderboard for competitive play, progressive difficulty scaling, and extensive polish for a commercial release on the Jio platform.

assetHub.title: AssetHub

avatarAsWebsites.title: Avatar as Websites

augury.title: AUGURY: Duel of the Gods
augury.description: Turn-based mind-game fighter where mythological gods duel. Both players lock in a move at once, so winning is about reading your opponent, not reaction speed.
augury.extendedDescription: A turn-based mind-game fighter made for the DreamLayer Jam, in the spirit of Your Only Move Is HUSTLE. Gods from different pantheons, like Anubis and Raijin, duel in a 2D arena: both players pick their moves at the same time, and each exchange plays out as freeze-frame poses. Arenas announce their hazards ahead of time, gods can rewrite the arena with their Domains, and correctly calling your opponent's move earns Divinity and a counter-hit. The character art was generated and iteratively edited with DreamLayer, so each god stays consistent across all their poses.
